cues: One centimetre over two thousand is five times ten to the minus four centimetres, which is five micrometres.
Two micrometres is what you get if you forget the centimetre.
text: B, five micrometres. One centimetre over two thousand is five times ten to the minus four centimetres, which is five micrometres. Two micrometres is what you get if you forget the centimetre.
